title: finding(docs): nothing checks that a `SchemaExample id="…"` in content/docs resolves in the schema catalog — `getExample` throws, at page render, in production docs
body:
Found while executing #6877 (adding a `components-basic-div/use-box-instead` migration example to `div.mdx`) — **not fixed there**, out of that card's scope.

## The gap

`apps/site/app/components/SchemaExample.tsx` resolves its `id` prop with `getExample(id)` from `@object-ui/example-schema-catalog`, and the generated `examples/schema-catalog/src/index.ts` implements that as:

```ts
export function getExample(id: string): Example {
  const entry = REGISTRY[id];
  if (!entry) {
    throw new Error(
      `Unknown example id: "${id}". Known ids: ${Object.keys(REGISTRY).join(', ')}`,
    );
  }
  return entry;
}
```

So a mistyped or stale id is a **throw at page render**, not a blank tile. 145 files in the tree carry a `SchemaExample` reference; `content/docs/**` is full of them.

**Nothing statically checks those ids.** Measured on `origin/main` @ `9f5de79dd`:

```
git grep -ln 'SchemaExample id=' -- scripts/ examples/ packages/
  examples/README.md
  examples/schema-catalog/README.md
  examples/schema-catalog/src/index.ts
  examples/schema-catalog/test/smoke.test.tsx
  scripts/__tests__/extract-mdx-demos.test.ts
  scripts/extract-mdx-demos.mjs
  scripts/regenerate-catalog-index.py
```
(control on the same command shape and population: `git grep -ln 'describe(' -- scripts/ examples/` → 162 files, so the reader was firing.)

None of those seven is a gate over `content/docs`:

- `scripts/extract-mdx-demos.mjs` is a one-file CLI (`Usage: node scripts/extract-mdx-demos.mjs <category> <file.mdx>`), not wired into `package.json` or any workflow — `grep -n 'extract-mdx-demos' package.json .github/workflows/*.yml` is empty.
- `scripts/__tests__/catalog-index-regenerable-4633.test.ts` checks that the generated index matches the **schemas directory**. It says nothing about who references those ids.
- `examples/schema-catalog/test/catalog-gallery-render.test.tsx` renders every **catalog entry**. An mdx pointing at an id that does not exist is invisible to it — the entry simply is not there to render.
- `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` walks `content/docs` but asks about component **type** literals, not example ids.

## Why it is worth a gate rather than a shrug

The failing direction is the expensive one: the id lives in a docs page, the throw happens in the rendered site, and the local signal a contributor gets is **green** — every check above passes on a docs page that will crash. The neighbouring class of defect has been filed repeatedly here (#5136, #6171, #7724 are docs that drifted from the tree), and this one is mechanically checkable in a way those were not: the id set is a generated registry and the references are a grep away.

## Suggested shape (for triage, not binding)

A `check:doc-example-ids` script that greps `content/docs/**` for `SchemaExample id="…"`, resolves each against the ids in `examples/schema-catalog/src/index.ts`, and reports the misses — with a positive control so a zero is a reading rather than a wrong glob. It is the same shape as the existing `check:doc-types` and would sit beside it in `lint.yml`.

## Not this

⛔ Not a proposal to make `getExample` return `undefined` — throwing on an unknown id is the right runtime behaviour. The gap is that nothing asks the question **before** render.
